final: WITH account_averages AS (SELECT t.account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(t.amount) AS account_avg FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3), region_averages AS (SELECT region, AVG(account_avg) AS region_avg FROM account_averages GROUP BY region), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(region_avg) AS overall_avg FROM region_averages), kept_regions AS (SELECT r.region, r.region_avg, r.region_avg - o.overall_avg AS difference FROM region_averages AS r JOIN overall_average AS o ON o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL WHERE r.region_avg > o.overall_avg), final_average AS (SELECT AVG(difference) AS final_avg FROM kept_regions) SELECT k.region, k.region_avg, k.difference, k.region_avg / f.final_avg AS ratio FROM kept_regions AS k JOIN final_average AS f ON f.final_avg IS NOT NULL
